description: Use this when you need to edit a param() default value in a kernelCAD script. Returns the modified code as text plus diagnostics from re-evaluating the result. Caller persists the new code via standard file-write tools (this tool has no side effects).

new_value.description: The new default value. Either a number for a numeric param (e.g. 12.5), or a string expression evaluated in the script (e.g. "width/2 + 3").

param_name.description: The string literal name of the param (first arg to param()).

name: set_param

binding_name.description: JS const name bound to the new construct (when one was created).

diagnostics.description: Diagnostics from re-evaluating the modified source.

error.description: Failure message (present when ok is false).

new_code.description: Modified .kcad.ts source (present on success). Caller persists it.

ok.description: Whether the edit applied and re-evaluated cleanly.

title: Set Parameter
